body:
“Nastasja didn’t just look at my website. She listened to the people I’m trying to reach: hundreds of real comments and searches from adults over 50 and brought back their exact words. She pointed out what was already working, flagged an outdated event I’d missed, rewrote my homepage opening word for word, and gave me five questions I’m still thinking about. She was upfront about what the research could and couldn’t prove, and that made me trust everything else.

If you want someone who combines sharp strategy with real heart, and who will tell you the truth about your message, work with Nastasja. She’s The Architect for a reason.”
attr: — Olelo paʻa Ogawa, The Aloha Chef · Glow Hawaii
